verdict.rationale: Adyen docs explicitly describe a dedicated testing system for POS integrations with test cards to simulate card brands, CVMs, and declined payments, allowing developers to validate their integration before going live. This is well documented across multiple doc pages with clear intent (pre-production validation). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer report confirming the simulator's fidelity or ease of use, and no detail on a fully simulated virtual reader (only physical test cards/terminals are described).
